This is a low-angle close-up shot focusing on the legs and feet of a person wearing ancient leg armor and war boots, standing on the ruins of a palace. Scattered small puddles are visible on the right side of the image. The person's legs are on the left side of the frame, with their feet crossed as if walking. They are wearing metal boots adorned with intricate patterns. In the dimly lit indoor setting at night, a rock wall can be seen in the distance. The image features soft, natural night lighting, creating an overall atmosphere of melancholy and contemplation,light blue fluorescence
